## PLEASE READ CAREFULLY

IBEW, Local Union 111 Dispatch Procedures

for taking a Referral in Local Union 111’s Jurisdiction

**1.** Prior to requesting a job,make sure you have **Signed the Books** following the instructions on“How to Sign the Books for Local Union 111.”

**2.** All jobs are posted on IBEW, Local Union 111’s website at [www.ibew111.org](http://www.ibew111.org/) under the **Dispatch Tab**. The website is updated Monday through Friday, excluding holidays, by **4:00 p.m.** (MST)for the following workday’s Dispatch.

**3.** To request a job, call [**(303)398-7 348**](tel:(303)398-7348) between **4:00 p.m. and 7:00 a.m**. (MST). Clearly state your name, phone number, and the job you are interested in.

**4.** Dispatch hours are from **7:30 a.m**. to **10:00 a.m.** (MST), Monday through Friday.

**5.** Every morning the messages are recorded and ordered by position on the Available for Work List (i.e.Books).

**6.** At 7:30 a.m. we call starting from the top of the List based on Book status.

**7.** If there is no answer, the job will be offered to the next person on the List.

**8.** If you do not receive a call, the position was filled by someone higher on the Available for Work List.

**9.** Please plan to go to the employer’s main office after you complete your new member paperwork at the Union Hall. Have work boots, long sleeve shirt, work gloves and transportation. **All of our Contractors perform pre-employment Drug Testing. If you believe this will be a problem, please Do Not waste your time or ours.**

AAM:gc/opeiu#30/afl-cio

Revised 11/11/2025

## SPECIAL NOTICE ITEMS

Please read the following items carefully. The information contained herein will help you understand the process of obtaining employment and may save you from experiencing problems.

1\. All opportunities for work placed by contractors throughout the day will be listed daily by 4:00 p.m. online on the IBEW, Local Union 111’s website at [**www.ibew111.org**](http://www.ibew111.org/) **,** click on the icon with three (3) bars in the upper right corner, then the Dispatch tab, and check the Job Calls, Communications, and Pathway tabs for information on upcoming job opportunities.

2. **In order to accept work, applicants must indicate their intent to accept the available position any time between 4:00 p.m. when jobs are posted on the Job Line and 7:00 a.m. the next working day with the qualifications outlined in the Manpower Request by leaving a message at (303) 398-7348, or being present at Local Union 111's Denver office by 7:30 a.m. Monday through Friday, holidays excluded. Any applicant who accepts a position by telephone or in person and does not report to the Contractor will be rolled to the end of the Available-for-Work List.**

3\. You may only registerfor one classification; however, you may sign any Book for which you are qualified, plus the Communications and Pathway Books.

4.Signing the Available-for-Work List shall be allowed on regular working days from 7:30 a.m. until 12:00 p.m. (noon), and 12:30 p.m. until3:30 p.m. any working day during the month. After initially signing the Books in person, individuals may sign the Available-for-Work List through the sign-up link on the website at [**www.ibew111.org**](http://www.ibew111.org/) under the Sign the Books tab. **Applicants who sign on the web-link will be registered on the Books the following morning of the next working day for Dispatch.**

**5.** The Available-for-Work List will be purged quarterly by means of **a Roll Call conducted on the first working day of each quarter**. **Roll Call will be conducted at 8:00 a.m. (MST) on the first working days of:** **January, April, July and October.** ‍

1. **Roll Call will be delayed until 8:30 a.m. on days of bad weather.**

2. **During Roll Call** anyone who is not present when his or her name is called or has not resigned electronically prior to 8:00 a.m. (MST) on the day of Roll Call will lose their place on the list and will be required to sign the Books in person or online. “Registrants” may retain their original place on the Books by completingthe Roll Call Re-Sign Formonline at [www.ibew111.org](http://www.ibew111.org/). Such requests shall only be recognized when received no earlier than the last week of the month preceding January, April, July and October. On Roll Call days, Dispatch will be done by first offering calls to applicants who show up in person. **Online Re-sign Forms received the day of Roll Call will be added to the bottom of the list in the order they are received.**

Thank you for your interest in the IBEW.

Sincerely,

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/png;base64,)

Austin Maier

## IBEW, LOCAL UNION 111 DENVER, COLORADO APPLICANT INTRODUCTION

By signing the Available-for-Work List, you are indicating your interest in receiving representation from one of the most powerful and progressive labor organizations in North America and will have the advantage of the protection and benefits of an IBEW Collective Bargaining Agreement.

‍ **Roll Call will take place on a quarterly basis in January, April, July and October.** You will be registered for work for the quarter in which you sign only, and as of the first working day of the following quarter your name will be removed from the List unless you indicate your continuing interest by following the Hiring Hall Rules regarding “ **Roll Call.**” Manpower Requests are assigned to the first qualified applicant, in order of registration.

Once you have accepted employment by referral from the Available-for-Work List you will be required to pay an Admission Fee within a specific time. The amount of the fee and the time period may vary as dictated by the specific language in the contract under which you will work.

‍ **Colorado is not a Right-to-Work state**; therefore, you will be obligated to pay your fair share of the expense of representation by the Local Union (a non-profit organization subject to federal audit). Or pay an equal share as an Agency Fee Payer to support the collective bargaining process. Once you have become a member, you will have certain rights and obligations, which are the foundation of our great organization. Generally, the cost of dues is less than what you are accustomed to paying for health insurance premiums, which are usually paid for in IBEW collective bargaining agreements along with pension and various other benefits of membership in the IBEW. You will have the opportunity to progress in the industry by taking advantage of available Apprenticeships or upgrade training provided to you for the cost of your monthly dues enabling you to earn while you learn.

## MEMBERSHIP APPLICANT INFORMATIONAL STATEMENT

All bargaining unit new hires must join the Union or pay an equal share as an Agency Fee Payer to support the Collective Bargaining process within a prescribed amount of time, identified by law from their date of hire. **The admission fee for “A” type membership is $52.00**.

**Monthly dues for “A” members are $54.70, payment is due on the first day of each month**.  Monthly dues payments are a personal responsibility. No reminder will be sent. Any member found to be in excess of three (3) months in arrears will be sent a letter informing them that they are being charged a reinstatement fee of $30.00 plus all past dues to date. **Arrearage in excess of six (6) months** will result in a letter being sent to their employer requiring the employee’s immediate termination.

‍ **A 1.9% working assessment is automatically deducted from each “A” member’s gross pay, or2% for those working under the Pathways Project**. These funds are paid directly to the Local Union by the Employer and are the financial base for the operation of the Local Union.
